as_told.title: JFK and LBJ visit Los Alamos weeks after Malmgren's briefing

plain: Harold Malmgren, who was an advisor to US presidents, is said to have been briefed in 1962 at Los Alamos, a government science laboratory in New Mexico, where he met a man named Lawrence Gise. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that about a month later President John F. Kennedy came out to Los Alamos in person, which Michels says was not a normal thing for him to do. Pippa Malmgren, telling the story for Harold Malmgren on the same show, says it was only a couple of weeks later, and that Kennedy, his vice president Lyndon B. Johnson and their teams all went. They tell it as a hint that whatever Malmgren was shown mattered enough to bring the president himself.
